blocks.doc: Opener lockup "<pre> [logo] <name>": the words slide in, the logo springs, an optional badge bubble pops, a sub line fades in
A big statement: 1–3 lines with an *accent* phrase, optional kicker label above and sub line below; words rise in one by one
Headline over a row of characters that spring up one after another and keep hopping (two rows on portrait)
A hero (character or logo) with 2–5 satellites (icon + label) flying out to it, joined by moving dotted lines; headline above
Headline beside a hero surrounded by orbiting app tiles in three rings; the tiles fling outward on a zoom-out exit
A big number that counts up (with ticks) and lands with a pop, a label under it and an optional sub line
Your own image or footage (live action, screen recording) full-bleed or in a phone/browser frame, with a slow Ken Burns move and an optional headline over a soft scrim
Closing lockup: logo + name, a tagline, CTA buttons, an optional URL and an optional row of characters hopping in
A phone running a UI flow (chat, cards, taps, toasts, agent steps, screenshots) beside a headline (above it on portrait)
A desktop browser / app window running a UI flow (with a mouse cursor for taps), headline above it
A floating UI panel (no device) running UI items
A big prompt box: placeholder → the task is typed with key ticks → send → optional agent steps tick off below

Reel title card: 1–4 heavy italic words slam in as a sticker (outline / plate / pill) with an impact shake, an optional kicker pill above and a ribbon tag below, over the shot's footage (bg) or over nothing (an overlay)
Before / after: two panels that pop in with label chips and an arrow (side), or one frame where a divider sweeps across to reveal the after image (wipe); optional sticker headline and caption

A floating card (an image, or a phone showing it) over the shot's dimmed footage (bg) or over nothing: flies in with a perspective swing and a speed streak, focus brackets snap around it with a label tag, then it bobs; optional sticker headline and caption

Comment-keyword end card ("Comment WORD to get the link"): the keyword slams in as an accent sticker, pre/post lines slide in, the logo pops on top, a chat bubble bounces; over the shot's footage (bg), a dark backdrop with drifting glows (no bg), or nothing (bg: none)
UI composited into footage: timed overlays pinned to the frame over the shot's bg (footage or an image, with optional cinema bars)

A light agent-at-work UI: optional user message, agent rows (avatar sliding in, name, shimmering status → ✓, a reply streamed like an LLM; the chat scrolls with a momentum move), then an optional bold streamed title with steps ticking off
"Your agents": a list of agents (mascot, name, sub) scrolling behind a fixed highlight slot

Kinetic lockup type: a big 1–2 line name settles (tracking, scale, blur, a glint) with an optional co-brand line above and an accent pill under; optional footage behind; through: true zooms it through the camera with heavy blur at the end
Co-brand card: [logo] Name × [partner logo] Partner with a pill under it and 4–6 blob mascots popping in and bouncing around it, on a light gradient; names type in letter by letter, the × pops

A deep 3D card stack: cards recede in perspective, cycle to the front one by one (fast, then slower), the last one turns to face the camera and settles; an optional status pill with a mascot lands over it
A floating video wall: tilted phone-ratio cards at three depths drifting with parallax under a slow camera dolly, colourful label chips on some cards, an optional centre headline on a soft glow
